	From:  Jeffrey C Gossett                           10/20/2000 11:25 AM
	

To: William Kelly/HOU/ECT@ECT, Darron C Giron/HOU/ECT@ECT, Dutch 
Quigley/HOU/ECT@ECT, David Baumbach/HOU/ECT@ECT, Kam Keiser/HOU/ECT@ECT
cc:  
Subject: Changing Deals

Effective immediately,  if anyone changes any deal for any reason,  they need 
to provide a minibook with a before and after of exactly what they did.  This 
used to be a common courtesy,  but it looks like we need a stated policy in 
place.  You guys will therefore have to get minibook access to calc all books 
on a mini-book level from Jeremy.  Please let me know the timing Jeremy gives 
for getting the appropriate people mini-book access as soon as possible.  It 
is critical that we get this done right away.  I know that this is not a 
one-sided issue.  No group is better or more important than any other group.  
It is therefore important that we do a better job of communicating across 
groups.

Thanks,

Jeff
